title: Creeper Parasites
description: Mobs have a small chance to be infected by nasty little creeper parasites
body:
## Have you ever wanted a little extra paranoia in your world?

- Have you ever thought, "You know what this game needs? More random explosions."

- Have you ever wished that every mob, regardless of how cute or harmless it looks, might suddenly decide to explode?

- Have you ever wanted the constant feeling that something is about to go boom, but you have absolutely no idea what?

- Do you want random cows which follow you at a terrifyingly suspicious slow pace?

### _**No?**_

Well, too bad. Here is this mod anyways


### Download this mod and never trust passive mobs again
